old: A householder-dvija should study three Vedas
new: A dvija who has undergone upanayana should study three Vedas
basis: Kannada p.491: ಉಪನೀತನಾದ ದ್ವಿಜನು (a dvija who has been invested with the thread), not a householder

old: loses all share in the heavenly fruit
new: has no share in the fruit
basis: Kannada p.493: ಫಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗ್ಯವೆಲ್ಲಿಯದು (share in the fruit); 'heavenly' not in Kannada

old: One should perform daily recitation each day
new: One should perform the Sandhya worship every day
basis: Kannada p.494: ಪ್ರತಿದಿನವೂ ಸಂಧ್ಯಾವಂದನೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು (Sandhya worship daily), not daily recitation

old: like saying one cannot marry until born, and cannot be born until married
new: like saying that the madness will not leave until one is married, and one will not marry until the madness leaves
basis: Kannada p.495: ಮದುವೆಯಾಗುವವರೆಗೂ ಹುಚ್ಚು ಬಿಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಹುಚ್ಚು ಬಿಡುವವರೆಗೂ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ

new: purely because all sacrificers accept it
basis: Kannada p.497: ಯಾಜ್ಞಿಕರೆಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಪ್ಪುವರು (all sacrificers agree)

old: is not directly observable at the moment of study itself, and study proceeds under specific rules and constraints, why should it need separate scriptural authority at all?
new: is plainly observable, why should study be bound by an injunction and rules, needing separate scriptural authority at all?
basis: Kannada p.503: ಇಂತಹ ಫಲವು ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿರುವಲ್ಲಿ, ವಿಧಿನಿಯಮಗಳಿಗೊಳಗಾಗಿ ... ಏಕೆ ಹೇಳಬೇಕು (the fruit is visible, so why an injunction); English had it reversed
Kannada p.505: ಅ. ೨. ಪಾ. ೧. ಸೂ. ೧ ರಿಂದ ೫

old: (For a fuller technical treatment of "apūrva," see the Jaimini-nyaya-mala-vistara, third adhyaya, first pada, sutras 1–3.)
basis: Kannada p.505 has one reference only (ಅ. ೨. ಪಾ. ೧. ಸೂ. ೧-೫); the 'third adhyaya, first pada, sutras 1-3' is not in the print, removed

old: that the study-injunction fails to reach those who already understand the Veda
new: that the meaning would not be obtained at all unless the injunction extends to knowledge of it
basis: Kannada p.513: ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯುವವರೆಗೂ ವೇದಾಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂಬ ವಿಧಿಯನ್ನು ಶಂಕಿಸಬೇಕಾಗಿಲ್ಲ; English had a different sense

old: If study's sole purpose were mere recitation (without regard to meaning), then studying the Veda expressly *in order to* understand its meaning would become pointless in the world.
new: If the injunction's purpose were only to know the meaning, then reciting the words in studying the Veda would become pointless in the world.
basis: Kannada p.516: ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಎನ್ನುವುದೇ ವಿಧಿಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶವಾಗಿದ್ದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಬ್ದೋಚ್ಚಾರಣಪೂರ್ವಕವಾದ ವೇದಾಧ್ಯಯನವು ವ್ಯರ್ಥ; roles reversed in English
Kannada p.517: ವಿಚಾರ ಉತ್ತರವಿಧಿಪ್ರಯೋಕ್ತ ಉಪಪದ್ಯತ ಇತಿ ॥ ೧೩ ॥
